scope: Focused local regression for omitted shared tempctr cleanup dependency

initial_fixture_correction.cause: New fixture attempted unsupported BackupError code cancelled; corrected to supported wrong-key. No product code changed.

assertions: Partial cleanup retains typed survivors even when container/volume/network names overlap.
Retries only retained objects, containers before volumes before networks, reverse creation order within kind.
Removal exit125 or BackupError plus unknown existence retains retry state; no false success.
Confirmed absence clears phantom tracking; successful cleanup is idempotent.
Explicit container/volume removal transport failure remains retryable.
Context exit preserves the primary import failure while retaining failed network cleanup for a later retry.

historical_sensitivity.log_normalization: Trailing whitespace removed from unittest subtest status lines only; no result or traceback content omitted.
Trailing whitespace removed from unittest subtest status lines only; no result or traceback content omitted.

historical_sensitivity_method: In isolated Python process, git show each historical tempctr.py, compile into an in-memory woowbackup module, patch only the new test module reference, run its five methods. No engine file replacement. Failure count includes failing subtests; it is not a count of failing methods.

next_minimal_real_rerun.required_for: Real-runtime corroboration of the shared cleanup dependency on the final integrated source; not commercial HA acceptance.
next_minimal_real_rerun.scope: One disposable rootless TempObjects lifecycle: one container, one volume, one internal network with unique job labels and already available image.
next_minimal_real_rerun.precondition: Target owner schedules and authorizes the probe after integrating this test commit; this lane neither contacts nor reserves .54 or any lab.
checks: Record exact final commit plus tempctr/podman/errors and probe hashes before execution.
Use a controlled one-shot runner fault for an owned object removal while actual inventory confirms it still exists; verify failure remains tracked.
Retry through real owner-side Podman removal, verify containers before volumes before network and final empty tracking.
Independently verify exact owned IDs/names/labels absent and pre-existing inventory unchanged; record bounded command exit/error and cleanup output.
next_minimal_real_rerun.limits: A controlled fault verifies retry plumbing, not every genuine storage/namespace failure. If final engine has further cleanup/runner changes, rebind and rerun the focused local tests first. Native ARM/cross-physical restore and >8GiB payload remain separate acceptance gaps.
